Under the general direction of the Small Animal Soft Tissue Surgery Supervisor and Chief of Service, provide administrative coordination and technical support to the Soft Tissue Surgery Service. The primary focus of this position will be to serve as a Technical Coordinator, facilitating the referral, scheduling, and coordination of Soft Tissue Surgery patients.

Responsibilities include coordinating and scheduling patient appointments and procedures; communicating with clients in person, by phone, and via email; obtaining, organizing, and uploading patient medical records; communicating with referring veterinarians; and coordinating consultations and patient care with various services throughout the Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital (VMTH).

This position will also provide paraveterinary technical support to Soft Tissue Surgery and the Operating Rooms as needed. Technical responsibilities include assisting with the daily receiving and coordination of outpatient and drop-off appointments, patient restraint and handling, carrying out prescribed treatments and medication administration, assisting with patient care and procedures, and circulating within the operating room.

The position requires strong communication, organization, and customer service skills, as well as the ability to coordinate multiple patient and service needs while working collaboratively with clients, clinicians, students, technicians, referring veterinarians, and other VMTH services.
